title: Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis
edition: PG 41-43; Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis (Khazarzar)
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: A fresh English translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s Testimonies from Scripture: 102 short statements about Christ, from His birth before the ages to His second coming, each followed by the passages of Scripture that bear witness to it.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis, made from the Greek of PG 41–43 (Khazarzar transcription). No modern English version was used as wording.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation from the Greek of PG 41–43 (Khazarzar transcription).
